atoms.标签: 2025 · 东莞第八高级中学 · 高一下期中
atoms.题干: Her ___ (believe) in the power of kindness encouraged her to volunteer at the local shelter every weekend.
atoms.题干HTML: Her (believe) in the power of kindness encouraged her to volunteer at the local shelter every weekend.
atoms.解析: 考查名词。句意：她对善良力量的信念鼓励她每个周末都去当地的收容所做志愿者。此处为名词作主语，believe的名词belief，意为“信念”，不可数名词。故填belief。
atoms.reason: 物主代词 Her 后用名词

atoms.标签: 2023 · 东莞中学松山湖学校 · 高一下月考
atoms.题干: We need to learn to accept people who have different ___ (believe) from ours.
atoms.题干HTML: We need to learn to accept people who have different (believe) from ours.
atoms.解析: 考查名词。句意：我们需要学会接受那些与我们有不同信仰的人。根据空前的different可知，这里应用名词。结合句意，这里表示“不同的信仰”，belief意为“信仰”时为可数名词。空前有different，所以这里应用名词复数。故填beliefs。

families.gloss:
物主代词后用名词
可数，复数指各种信仰

atoms.标签: 2025 · 光正实验学校 · 高一下期中
atoms.题干: As we all know, the kind of dictionary is of great ___ (significant) to us.
atoms.题干HTML: As we all know, the kind of dictionary is of great (significant) to us.
atoms.解析: 考查名词。句意：众所周知，这种字典对我们非常重要。“be of great + 名词”是固定结构，相当于“be + 形容词”，所以用名词significance作介词宾语，意为“重要性”。故填significance。

families.gloss:
of great 后用名词
形容词 significant 的名词

atoms.标签: 2026 · 大岭山中学 · 高一下期中
atoms.题干: I offer you my sincere ___ (congratulate) on your success.
atoms.题干HTML: I offer you my sincere (congratulate) on your success.
atoms.解析: 句意：我对你的成功致以真诚的祝贺。空处应填入名词，作offer的直接宾语，congratulate的名词形式为congratulation，此时应用其复数形式congratulations，意为“道贺，恭喜”。
atoms.reason: sincere 后用名词，复数表祝贺

families.gloss:
形容词后用名词
复数表示祝贺的话

atoms.标签: 2025 · 光正实验学校 · 高一下期中
atoms.题干: We took steps to ensure that rule should be ___ (faithful) carried out.
atoms.题干HTML: We took steps to ensure that rule should be (faithful) carried out.
atoms.解析: 考查副词。句意：我们采取措施确保规则能被准确地执行。提示词修饰动词carried，用副词faithfully作状语，意为“准确地，如实地”。故填faithfully。
atoms.reason: 修饰过去分词 carried，用副词

families.gloss:
be 与过去分词之间用副词
形容词 faithful 的副词

atoms.标签: 2025 · 厚街中学 · 高一下月考
atoms.题干: The festival is celebrated ___ (merry) across the country.
atoms.题干HTML: The festival is celebrated (merry) across the country.
atoms.解析: 考查副词。句意：全国上下都在欢天喜地地庆祝这个节日。空处修饰动词celebrated，应填副词作状语，故填merrily。

families.gloss:
修饰被动谓语用副词
形容词 merry 的副词

atoms.标签: 2023 · 东莞实验中学 · 高一下月考
atoms.题干: It is generally believed that our English teacher is a knowledgeable, trustworthy and ___ (respect) woman.
atoms.题干HTML: It is generally believed that our English teacher is a knowledgeable, trustworthy and (respect) woman.
atoms.解析: 考查形容词。句意：普遍认为，我们英语老师是一个博学的、值得信任以及值得尊敬的人。根据空前的knowledgeable，trustworthy可知，此处应用形容词“respectable值得尊敬的”与空前的形容词构成并列，作定语，修饰名词woman，故填respectable。

atoms.标签: 2026 · 万江中学 · 高二下期中
atoms.题干: Located in the east and west of the city, the two campuses cover 200 and 350 square kilometers ___ (respective).
atoms.题干HTML: Located in the east and west of the city, the two campuses cover 200 and 350 square kilometers (respective).
atoms.解析: 句意：两个校区分别坐落于城市东部和西部，占地200和350平方公里。此处修饰动词作状语，需用副词，respective对应的副词形式为respectively，意为“分别地”。

families.gloss:
并列形容词后用形容词
表示各自、分别用副词

spelling.标签: 2024 · 东华高级中学 · 高一下月考
spelling.题干: One example is the ___ (典型的，有代表性的) Chinese Spring Festival custom of lighting firecrackers to drive away the evil spirits and celebrate the New Year.
spelling.题干HTML: One example is the (典型的，有代表性的) Chinese Spring Festival custom of lighting firecrackers to drive away the evil spirits and celebrate the New Year.
spelling.解析: 考查形容词。句意：举个例子，典型的中国春节习俗是放鞭炮驱除邪灵，庆祝新年。根据句意和汉语提示可知，应使用形容词typical作定语，修饰名词词组Chinese Spring Festival custom。故填typical。
spelling.reason: 修饰 custom，形容词作定语

spelling.标签: 2023 · 东华高级中学 · 高一下月考
spelling.题干: There are many shops in the ___ (商业的) heart of the city.
spelling.题干HTML: There are many shops in the (商业的) heart of the city.
spelling.解析: 考查形容词。句意：这个城市的商业中心有很多商店。根据汉语提示可知，commercial“商业的”，形容词，在句中作定语修饰名词heart，故填commercial。
spelling.reason: heart 前用形容词作定语

spelling.标签: 2024 · 东华高级中学 · 高一下月考
spelling.题干: I enjoy reading books, but I only have ___ (偶尔的) time for it due to my busy schedule.
spelling.题干HTML: I enjoy reading books, but I only have (偶尔的) time for it due to my busy schedule.
spelling.解析: 考查形容词。句意：我喜欢读书，但由于日程繁忙，我只有偶尔的时间。空处作定语修饰名词time，结合汉语提示可知，形容词occasional符合题意。故填occasional。
spelling.reason: 修饰 time，形容词

spelling.标签: 2023 · 东华高级中学 · 高一下月考
spelling.题干: The weather at the moment is not ___ (典型的) for July, for it hasn't rained for more than half a month.
spelling.题干HTML: The weather at the moment is not (典型的) for July, for it hasn't rained for more than half a month.
spelling.解析: 考查形容词。句意：现在的天气不是七月的典型天气，因为已经半个多月没下雨了。设空处在系动词后，应用形容词，“典型的”表达为typical，作表语。故填typical。
spelling.reason: 系动词 is 后用形容词作表语

spelling.标签: 2023 · 东莞中学松山湖学校 · 高一下月考
spelling.题干: Wilson was ___ (代表) in court by a top criminal lawyer.
spelling.题干HTML: Wilson was (代表) in court by a top criminal lawyer.
spelling.解析: 考查动词。句意：Wilson在法庭上由一位顶级刑事律师所代表。根据汉语提示可知，represent代表，动词，句子是一般过去时的被动语态，空处应填过去分词，故填represented。
spelling.reason: was 后用过去分词，构成被动语态

tricks.formula: 她第一次参加运动会。 → It is the first time that …

atoms.标签: 2023 · 东莞外国语学校 · 高一上月考
atoms.题干: 这是她第一次参加运动会。 → ___
atoms.题干HTML: 这是她第一次参加运动会。 →
cue: 用It is the first time that...翻译
atoms.答案: It is the first time that she has taken part in the sports meeting.
atoms.解析: 考查固定句型和固定短语。根据提示，本题用固定句型It is the first time that sb. have/has done表示“某人第一次做某事”，that引导的从句应用现在完成时，“参加”可用take part in表达，作从句谓语，用现在完成时，主语she是第三人称单数，助动词用has，“运动会”用sports meeting表达，此处为特指，用定冠词the修饰。故翻译为It is the first time that she has taken part in the sports meeting.

quiz.标签: 2026 · 东莞第十二高级中学 · 高一下期中
quiz.题干: So far, rich learning materials ___ (gather) for students on this educational platform.
quiz.题干HTML: So far, rich learning materials (gather) for students on this educational platform.
quiz.解析: 句意：到目前为止，这个教育平台已经为学生收集了丰富的学习资料。根据时间状语“So far”及复数主语materials与gather的动宾关系可知，此空应是现在完成时的被动语态have been gathered，作谓语。

quiz.标签: 2026 · 翰林高级中学 · 高一月考
quiz.题干: At the temple fair, red ___ (lantern) hang everywhere, making the night bright and cheerful.
quiz.题干HTML: At the temple fair, red (lantern) hang everywhere, making the night bright and cheerful.
quiz.解析: 句意：在庙会上，到处都挂着红灯笼，让夜晚变得明亮而欢快。lantern为可数名词，根据谓语动词hang可知，此处应用其复数形式作主语。
quiz.reason: hang 为复数，名词用复数

quiz.标签: 2026 · 济川中学 · 高一下期中
quiz.题干: People can take part in many interesting events, ___ (range) from dragon boat races to lantern riddles and group singing.
quiz.题干HTML: People can take part in many interesting events, (range) from dragon boat races to lantern riddles and group singing.
quiz.解析: 句意：人们可以参加许多有趣的活动，包括龙舟比赛、猜灯谜以及集体唱歌等等。此处range与events构成主动关系，故用现在分词作后置定语。

quiz.标签: 2025 · 东莞市 · 高一下联考
quiz.题干: A young boy climbed into the apple tree and shook its ___ (branch) so that the fruit fell down.
quiz.题干HTML: A young boy climbed into the apple tree and shook its (branch) so that the fruit fell down.
quiz.解析: 考查名词复数。句意：一个小男孩爬上苹果树，摇晃着它的树枝，让苹果掉了下来。branch，意为 “树枝”，为可数名词。根据语境，男孩摇晃的是苹果树的多个树枝，所以这里应用复数形式作宾语。故填branches。
quiz.reason: its 指多根枝条，用复数

quiz.标签: 2022 · 东莞市 · 高一下期末
quiz.题干: During the Spring Festival, people will wander along the streets ___ (decorate) with red lanterns.
quiz.题干HTML: During the Spring Festival, people will wander along the streets (decorate) with red lanterns.
quiz.解析: 考查过去分词。句意：春节期间，人们会在挂满红灯笼的街道上漫步。句中已有谓语动词will wonder且无连词，故空处应填非谓语动词；动词decorate和streets之间是动宾关系，应用过去分词作后置定语。故填decorated。

quiz.标签: 2025 · 光正实验学校 · 高一下期中
quiz.题干: The movie, ___ (feature) traditional Chinese culture, has been well received since it was put on.
quiz.题干HTML: The movie, (feature) traditional Chinese culture, has been well received since it was put on.
quiz.解析: 考查现在分词。句意：这部以中国传统文化为特色的电影自上映以来广受好评。空处为非谓语动词，逻辑主语The movie与非谓语动词feature为主动关系，feature用现在分词形式作定语。故填featuring。
quiz.reason: 作非限定定语，现在分词

atoms.标签: 2019 · 北师大石竹附属学校 · 高一下期中
atoms.题干: More and more people have realized that staying up late is ___ (harm) to our health.
atoms.题干HTML: More and more people have realized that staying up late is (harm) to our health.
atoms.解析: be harmful to对……有害，是固定搭配。故填harmful。
atoms.句意: 越来越多的人意识到熬夜对我们的健康有害。

families.gloss:
is 等系动词后用形容词
harm 的形容词形式

atoms.标签: 2025 · 光正实验学校 · 高一下期中
atoms.题干: She responded with a “Thank you” in ___ (respond) to the stranger’s kindness.
atoms.题干HTML: She responded with a “Thank you” in (respond) to the stranger’s kindness.
atoms.解析: 考查名词。句意：作为对陌生人好意的回应，她说了句“谢谢”。空格处用名词作宾语，respond的名词是response，意为“回应”，是不可数名词，in response to意为“作为对……的回应”，因此空格处是response。故填response。
atoms.reason: in 后作介词宾语，用名词

families.gloss:
介词 in 后用名词
in response to 作为对……的回答

atoms.标签: 2026 · 海逸外国语学校 · 高一下期中
atoms.题干: I felt ___ (scare) when I walked alone in the dark street last night.
atoms.题干HTML: I felt (scare) when I walked alone in the dark street last night.
atoms.解析: 句意：昨晚我独自走在漆黑的街道上时，感到十分害怕。felt是系动词，后需要接形容词作表语，说明主语I的状态，因此要用scared，表示“（人）感到害怕的”。

families.gloss:
felt 等系动词后用形容词
-ed 形容词表示感受

spelling.标签: 2021 · 东华高级中学 · 高二下期末
spelling.题干: The survey shows that the ___ (大多数) of the students are in favour of the teaching reform.
spelling.题干HTML: The survey shows that the (大多数) of the students are in favour of the teaching reform.
spelling.解析: 考查名词。句意：调查显示大多数学生赞成教学改革。分析句子，设空处使用名词作主语，表示“大多数”用majority。故填majority。
spelling.reason: the 后用名词，表示大多数

spelling.标签: 2024 · 东华高级中学 · 高一下月考
spelling.题干: The company offers ___ (灵活的) working hours to accommodate employees’ personal schedules.
spelling.题干HTML: The company offers (灵活的) working hours to accommodate employees’ personal schedules.
spelling.解析: 考查形容词。句意：公司提供灵活的工作时间以适应员工的个人时间安排。空处作定语修饰名词辞去working hours，结合汉语提示可知，形容词flexible符合题意。故填flexible。
spelling.reason: 修饰 working hours，形容词

spelling.标签: 2024 · 东华高级中学 · 高一下月考
spelling.题干: He was faced with the ___ (进退两难的局面) of whether or not to return to his country.
spelling.题干HTML: He was faced with the (进退两难的局面) of whether or not to return to his country.
spelling.解析: 考查名词。句意：他面临着是否回国的两难境地。根据汉语提示可知，dilemma“进退两难的局面”，可数名词，此处表示特指，应用单数形式，在句中作介词with的宾语，故填dilemma。
spelling.reason: the 后用名词，指困境

spelling.标签: 2023 · 东莞中学松山湖学校 · 高一下月考
spelling.题干: Did you notice the ___ (眼泪)in his eyes when he talked about Diane?
spelling.题干HTML: Did you notice the (眼泪)in his eyes when he talked about Diane?
spelling.解析: 考查名词。句意：你注意到他谈到戴安时眼中的泪水了吗?分析句子结构可知，空前是冠词，所以空处应填名词，根据所给中文提示词，应是tear意为“眼泪”，为可数名词，此处用复数形式。故填tears。
spelling.reason: tears 复数，指多滴眼泪

spelling.标签: 2024 · 东华高级中学、东华松山湖高级中学 · 高一下期中
spelling.题干: “I got it,” Lily said again in a near ___ (耳语).
spelling.题干HTML: “I got it,” Lily said again in a near (耳语).
spelling.解析: 考查名词。句意：“我明白了。” Lily又用近乎耳语的声音说了一遍。根据提示的汉语，表示“耳语”应为whisper作宾语，且空前有不定冠词a，所以使用名词单数形式。故填whisper。
spelling.reason: 形容词 near 后用名词

spelling.标签: 2018 · 东华高级中学 · 高二上期末
spelling.题干: We must ___ (任命；委派) a new teacher at once to the mountain school.
spelling.题干HTML: We must (任命；委派) a new teacher at once to the mountain school.
spelling.解析: 考查翻译填空，要翻译的部分为“委派”，作谓语，所以用动词，前面有情态动词，所以用动词原形，故填appoint。
spelling.句意: 我们必须立刻给山区学校委派一名新教师。
spelling.reason: 情态动词 must 后用原形

spelling.标签: 2023 · 东华高级中学 · 高一下期中
spelling.题干: We should stick to the principles and be ___ （灵活的）as well.
spelling.题干HTML: We should stick to the principles and be （灵活的）as well.
spelling.解析: 考查形容词。句意：我们既要坚持原则，又要灵活变通。“be”后跟形容词作表语，“灵活的”的形容词是flexible，故填flexible。
spelling.reason: be 后用形容词作表语

spelling.标签: 2020 · 东莞中学 · 高二上月考
spelling.题干: The advice that the law needs amending was ___ (拒绝) by them.
spelling.题干HTML: The advice that the law needs amending was (拒绝) by them.
spelling.解析: advice与reject之间是动宾关系，要用一般过去时的被动语态。故填rejected。
spelling.句意: 法律需要修改的建议被他们拒绝了。
spelling.reason: advice 与 reject 构成被动

tricks.formula: sb has donated sth → sth has been donated

atoms.标签: 2025 · 虎门外国语学校 · 高一下联考
atoms.题干: The generous man has donated large amounts of money to the charity organization → ___
atoms.题干HTML: The generous man has donated large amounts of money to the charity organization →
atoms.答案: Large amounts of money have been donated to the charity organization by the generous man.
atoms.解析: 考查被动语态。句意：这个慷慨的人已经向慈善组织捐赠了大量的钱。要将其改为被动语态，我们需要将原句中的宾语“large amounts of money”变为主语，将主语“the generous man”变为由介词“by”引导的宾语；原句中的谓语为“has donated”改为“have/has been done”的形式，主语money有large amounts of修饰，谓语动词使用复数形式。故答案是：Large amounts of money have been donated to the charity organization by the generous man.。

quiz.标签: 2026 · 海逸外国语学校 · 高一下期中
quiz.题干: We all saw Mary ___ （complain） about the food at the party the other day.
quiz.题干HTML: We all saw Mary （complain） about the food at the party the other day.
quiz.解析: 句意：前几天我们都看见玛丽在派对上抱怨食物。根据固定搭配see sb. do sth.（看见某人做某事，强调动作全过程），此处用动词原形。
quiz.reason: see sb do，省 to 用原形

quiz.标签: 2026 · 石龙中学 · 高一下期中
quiz.题干: Rare animals ___ (harm) if people keep destroying their living places.
quiz.题干HTML: Rare animals (harm) if people keep destroying their living places.
quiz.解析: 句意：如果人类持续破坏栖息地，珍稀动物将会受到伤害。 if 引导条件状语从句遵循主将从现，主语 animals与 harm为被动关系，用一般将来时的被动语态。
quiz.reason: animals 为受事，用将来被动

quiz.标签: 2025 · 东莞市 · 高一下联考
quiz.题干: His application ___ (reject) once again, which made him disappointed.
quiz.题干HTML: His application (reject) once again, which made him disappointed.
quiz.解析: 考查时态和语态。句意：他的申请再次被拒绝，这使他失望。根据句中“made”可知，句子陈述的是过去发生的事，“reject”意为“拒绝”，动词词性，“application”和“reject”为被动关系，故句子应用一般过去时的被动语态，“application”和“was”连用，“reject”的过去分词为“rejected”，故空格处应填“was rejected”。故填was rejected。

quiz.标签: 2024 · 东莞市 · 高一下联考
quiz.题干: Having worked in the kindergarten for three ___ (decade), they retired.
quiz.题干HTML: Having worked in the kindergarten for three (decade), they retired.
quiz.解析: 考查名词。句意：在幼儿园工作了三十年后，他们退休了。three后接复数decades，作宾语。故填decades。

atoms.标签: 2026 · 众美中学 · 高二下月考
atoms.题干: ___ (fortune), the interviewer spoke highly of him during the interview, so he was accepted.

atoms.题干: As a chain of education reforms has taken place, there is a need for greater ___ (diverse) and choices in education.
atoms.题干HTML: As a chain of education reforms has taken place, there is a need for greater (diverse) and choices in education.

spelling.标签: 2023 · 东莞中学松山湖学校 · 高一下月考
spelling.题干: After they got married, they ___ (定居)in Brooklyn.
spelling.题干HTML: After they got married, they (定居)in Brooklyn.
spelling.解析: 考查动词。句意：他们结婚后定居布鲁克林。根据汉语提示可知应填动词settle“定居；安家”，作谓语，结合got可知为一般过去时。故填settled。
spelling.reason: 过去时，不及物动词 settle

spelling.标签: 2023 · 东华高级中学 · 高一下期中
spelling.题干: The whole community were pleased with the news that a new commercial center was under ___ (建造) and related facilities would be provided.
spelling.题干HTML: The whole community were pleased with the news that a new commercial center was under (建造) and related facilities would be provided.
spelling.解析: 考查名词。句意：整个社区都很高兴听到一个新的商业中心正在建造中，并将提供相关设施的消息。根据“a new commercial center”和汉语提示可知，空处应用名词construction，作under的宾语，组成固定短语under construction，意为“正在建造中”。故填construction。
spelling.reason: under 后用名词，表示在建

spelling.标签: 2023 · 东莞中学松山湖学校 · 高一下月考
spelling.题干: Her attitude has ___ (确定无疑) changed for the better since she started this new job.
spelling.题干HTML: Her attitude has (确定无疑) changed for the better since she started this new job.
spelling.解析: 考查副词。句意：自从她开始这份新工作以来，她的态度确定无疑地变好了。根据汉语提示“确定无疑”可知，空格处应用“definitely”，意为“确定无疑，肯定”，副词词性，在句中作状语。故填definitely。
spelling.reason: 修饰 changed，副词

spelling.标签: 2023 · 东莞中学松山湖学校 · 高一下月考
spelling.题干: “Are you actively ___ (寻找) jobs?” she asked.
spelling.题干HTML: “Are you actively (寻找) jobs?” she asked.
spelling.解析: 考查动词。句意：“你有在积极找工作吗？”她问道。根据空后的jobs和汉语提示可知，应用及物动词seek。根据句意和句中的Are可知，句子表示正在寻找，应用现在进行时，空处应用seek的现在分词形式。故填seeking。
spelling.reason: are…actively 用现在进行时

phrases.释义: 寻找成功致富之路；闯世界
phrases.gloss:
seek 的过去式用 sought
one's 随主语人称变化

atoms.标签: 2023 · 东莞外国语学校 · 高一下期中
atoms.题干: Some Chinese immigrants have ___ (闯世界) in San Francisco for many years.
atoms.题干HTML: Some Chinese immigrants have (闯世界) in San Francisco for many years.
atoms.解析: 考查固定短语。句意：一些中国移民多年来一直在旧金山寻找财富。分析句子可知，空处可使用固定短语seek one's fortune在句中作谓语，意为“寻找成功致富之路；闯世界”，主语Some Chinese immigrants（一些中国移民）为复数形式，因此需使用表示复数的形容词性物主代词their。该句使用了现在完成时，因此空处需使用过去分词形式。故填①sought②their③fortune。
atoms.reason: 过去式 sought，one's 用 their

quiz.标签: 2024 · 东莞市 · 高一下联考
quiz.题干: ___ (admit) into a key university, the girl was very excited.
quiz.题干HTML: (admit) into a key university, the girl was very excited.
quiz.解析: 考查非谓语动词。做原因状语，admit和主语the girl是被动关系，用过去分词Admitted。故填admitted。

quiz.标签: 2024 · 东莞市 · 高一下期末
quiz.题干: Parents consider it a duty ___ (select) healthy foods for their children.
quiz.题干HTML: Parents consider it a duty (select) healthy foods for their children.
quiz.解析: 考查非谓语动词。句意：父母认为为孩子选择健康的食物是一种责任。句中it作形式宾语，这里应填不定式作真正宾语，故填to select。
quiz.reason: duty 后用不定式作定语

quiz.标签: 2023 · 东华高级中学 · 高一下期中
quiz.题干: ___ (earn) a living, some people opened up shops and restaurants in Chinatown.
quiz.题干HTML: (earn) a living, some people opened up shops and restaurants in Chinatown.
quiz.解析: 考查非谓语动词。句意：为了谋生，有些人在唐人街开商店和餐馆。句中用不定式作目的状语。根据句意，故填To earn。

atoms.标签: 2022 · 东莞中学松山湖学校 · 高一上月考
atoms.题干: He had a heated ___ (argue)with his mother about the problem for hours.
atoms.题干HTML: He had a heated (argue)with his mother about the problem for hours.

atoms.标签: 2025 · 东莞市 · 高一下期末
atoms.题干: They were ___ (disappoint) when the concert was canceled due to heavy rain and strong winds.
atoms.题干HTML: They were (disappoint) when the concert was canceled due to heavy rain and strong winds.
atoms.解析: 考查形容词。句意：音乐会由于大风和大雨被取消了，他们对此感到很失望。空处应填形容词作表语，主语为they，因此空处应使用disappointed，表示“感到失望的”。故填disappointed。

spelling.标签: 2023 · 东莞中学松山湖学校 · 高一下月考
spelling.题干: A test satellite was ___ (发射) from Cape Canaveral.
spelling.题干HTML: A test satellite was (发射) from Cape Canaveral.
spelling.解析: 考查动词。句意：卡纳维拉尔角发射了一颗试验卫星。根据汉语提示和空处所在位置，应用及物动词launch，主语A test satellite和launch之间是动宾关系，应用被动语态。空前有was，所以空处应填launch的过去分词形式。故填launched。

spelling.标签: 2023 · 东莞中学松山湖学校 · 高一下月考
spelling.题干: She had a burning ___ (渴望) to go back to her home country before she died.
spelling.题干HTML: She had a burning (渴望) to go back to her home country before she died.
spelling.解析: 考查名词。句意：她有一种强烈的愿望，想死前回到自己的祖国。根据空前的a和汉语提示，这里应用名词desire“愿望，渴望”，可以作可数名词。have a desire to do sth.意为“有做某事的渴望”。故填desire。

spelling.题干: The ___ (信号) for a race to start is often the firing of a gun.
spelling.题干HTML: The (信号) for a race to start is often the firing of a gun.

spelling.标签: 2021 · 东华高级中学 · 高二下期末
spelling.题干: Some people are bound to fail because they are ___ (缺乏的) in diligence and perseverance.
spelling.题干HTML: Some people are bound to fail because they are (缺乏的) in diligence and perseverance.
spelling.解析: 考查形容词。句意：有些人注定要失败，因为他们缺乏勤奋和毅力。分析句子，表示“缺乏的”使用形容词lacking作表语。故填lacking。

spelling.标签: 2020 · 东莞中学 · 高二上月考
spelling.题干: The child seems to be ___ (缺乏) in intelligence.
spelling.题干HTML: The child seems to be (缺乏) in intelligence.

quiz.标签: 2025 · 东莞市 · 高一下期末
quiz.题干: ___ (launch) this new project, the company has conducted many surveys.
quiz.题干HTML: (launch) this new project, the company has conducted many surveys.

quiz.题干HTML: At present, schools in Dongguan are equipped with many advanced teaching (facility).

quiz.标签: 2022 · 东莞外国语学校 · 高一上期中
quiz.题干: There have been a couple of young men and women ___ (argue) in the street.
quiz.题干HTML: There have been a couple of young men and women (argue) in the street.
cue: 用所给词的适当形式填空
quiz.解析: 考查非谓语动词。句意：有一对年轻男女在街上争吵。分析句子可知，空处作a couple of young man and woman的后置定语，表示“一对正在争吵的年轻男女”，argue和a couple of young man and woman逻辑上是主动关系，应用argue的现在分词形式arguing。故填arguing。

atoms.题干: You may leave the classroom with your teacher’s ___ (permit).
atoms.题干HTML: You may leave the classroom with your teacher’s (permit).

spelling.标签: 2024 · 东华高级中学、东华松山湖高级中学 · 高一下期中
spelling.题干: Please do not ___ (犹豫；迟疑) to contact me if you have any questions.
spelling.题干HTML: Please do not (犹豫；迟疑) to contact me if you have any questions.
spelling.解析: 考查动词。句意：如果您有任何问题，请不要犹豫联系我。根据句意及汉语提示可知，空处应填动词hesitate“犹豫，迟疑”，此句为祈使句的否定形式，do not后应用动词原形。故填hesitate。

spelling.标签: 2018 · 东华高级中学 · 高二上期末
spelling.题干: It's illegal to read people's private letters without ___ (允许).
spelling.题干HTML: It's illegal to read people's private letters without (允许).
spelling.解析: permission是一个名词，意为“允许”，without是介词，后面应该跟动名词，因此此处填名词permission，without permission意为“未经允许”。
spelling.句意: 未经允许阅读他人的私人信件是违法的。
spelling.reason: without 后用名词

spelling.标签: 2021 · 东华高级中学 · 高二下期末
spelling.题干: He made an ___ (道歉)to me for what he said.
spelling.题干HTML: He made an (道歉)to me for what he said.
spelling.解析: 考查名词。句意：他为他所说的话向我道歉。根据汉语意思提示可知，此处为名词apology“道歉”，满足句意要求。故填apology。

spelling.标签: 2024 · 东华高级中学、东华松山湖高级中学 · 高一下期中
spelling.题干: She tries not to use her phone when she studies, but it’s hard to ___ (忽视).
spelling.题干HTML: She tries not to use her phone when she studies, but it’s hard to (忽视).

spelling.reason: hard to 后用动词原形

spelling.标签: 2024 · 东华高级中学、东华松山湖高级中学 · 高一下期中
spelling.题干: It takes time and ___ (耐心) to learn a language.
spelling.题干HTML: It takes time and (耐心) to learn a language.

spelling.reason: 与 time 并列，用名词

spelling.标签: 2023 · 东华高级中学 · 高一下期中
spelling.题干: She returned to London to ___ (追求) her acting career.
spelling.题干HTML: She returned to London to (追求) her acting career.

quiz.题干HTML: One of the most important (element) of being a good friend is listening carefully.

quiz.标签: 2024 · 东莞中学松山湖学校 · 高一上期中
quiz.题干: Palestinians have long demanded that refugees (难民) ___ (permit) to return home.
quiz.题干HTML: Palestinians have long demanded that refugees (难民) (permit) to return home.
quiz.解析: 考查虚拟语气。句意：巴勒斯坦人长期以来一直要求允许难民返回家园。此处宾语从句用虚拟语气，谓语用should+动词原形，should可以省略；且permit与主语构成被动关系，故填should be permitted/be permitted。
